snapshot.baseline: Proposed source-controlled prompt/model registry; no model is production-approved here

records.name: Structured daily plan generation
records.model_policy: Primary/fallback selected only after staging benchmark
records.retention: Invocation metadata only; no long-term raw health prompt
records.evaluation: structure, evidence, citation, personalization and clinical-safety suite

records.name: Citation and claim validation
records.model_policy: Deterministic checks first; model assistance cannot override missing source
records.evaluation: source identity, claim support and unverifiable-claim fail-closed cases

records.name: Clinical-safety classification
records.model_policy: Gateway-selected classifier with deterministic red-flag rules
records.retention: Decision/reason codes only; no raw health prompt
records.evaluation: red flags, contraindication, diagnostic-claim and escalation fixtures

records.name: Non-identifying plan media generation
records.model_policy: Approved primary/fallback or permanent category fallback
records.retention: Versioned prompt template and asset hash; no health answers or identifiers
records.evaluation: reachability, dimensions, category fit, duplicate hash and safety scan

records.name: Typed conversation response
records.model_policy: Provider-neutral port; real provider composition pending
records.retention: Canonical user/assistant messages in conversation tables; invocation telemetry records HMAC hashes and metadata only
records.evaluation: general, care_plan, symptom_checkin, support, weekly_checkin contracts plus deterministic safety fixtures

records.name: Versioned conversation summary
records.retention: Summary is health data and follows conversation erasure/retention
records.evaluation: coverage boundary, factuality and deletion propagation

records.name: Weekly check-in guidance
records.model_policy: Gateway-selected model; questions come from versioned definitions
records.retention: Canonical messages/responses only; telemetry excludes contents
records.evaluation: definition adherence, schedule behavior, safety and completion fixtures

records.name: Plan quality and safety evaluation
records.model_policy: Evaluator model isolated from generator selection
records.retention: Structured scores/reason codes; raw response expires under approved policy
records.evaluation: golden fixtures, inter-rater consistency and cost/latency limits

records.name: Health free-text structuring
records.retention: Structured assessment field only; invocation telemetry excludes input
records.evaluation: schema validity, no invented facts, unsafe-input and timeout fixtures
